categories.name: Functional correctness
checks: Paste → parse → save → display golden path works end-to-end
Re-pasting the same day is idempotent (no duplicate events)
Last-nap and last-feed cards reflect the most recent events across all sources
Time strings without AM/PM are correctly disambiguated for a baby's daytime schedule
Outings parsed as type=outing, not lost in freeform
Diaper lines with combined wet/bm attributes are one event with two flags

categories.name: Data integrity
checks: Timestamps stored as UTC, rendered in family TZ
DB constraints (NOT NULL, FK, CHECK) match Zod schemas
JSON event payloads validate on every write
Migrations are forward-only and idempotent

categories.name: Security (OWASP)
checks: RLS enabled on every user-data table with correct policies
Service-role key only used server-side
Anthropic + VAPID keys never bundled to the client
Parse endpoint requires auth + has a per-user rate limit
User-pasted text rendered safely (no unsanitized HTML)

categories.name: Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
checks: Contrast ratios meet AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text and UI)
All interactive elements keyboard-reachable with visible focus
Charts have accessible alternative (data table or aria summary)
Form errors associated via aria-describedby
Info not conveyed by color alone

categories.name: Performance
checks: Today route initial JS < 150KB gzipped
LCP hero card not blocked by chart bundles
Stats charts code-split off the today route
Single DB round-trip per page where feasible

categories.name: Mobile + PWA
checks: Manifest valid (name, short_name, 192/512 icons, standalone)
Service worker installs and caches app shell
Push subscription works in iOS PWA mode
Touch targets ≥ 44pt
Safe-area insets respected

categories.name: Error / empty / loading states
checks: Every async surface has loading, error, empty states
Claude API failure offers retry and a manual-save fallback
Parser low-confidence events flagged for review
Offline indicator shown when navigator.onLine is false

categories.name: App-specific edge cases
checks: Note pasted late at night with events past midnight assigned to correct day
Overlapping naps surface a warning
Feed with no oz amount (nursing) counted as a feed but excluded from oz totals
Historical backfill doesn't corrupt the today view
DST transition days show 23/25h gracefully, not as a bug
Concurrent paste from two devices doesn't lose data
